messages.subject: App that works locally does not work, when deployed to shinyapps.io

With Best Reagrds,
Mait

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App that works locally does not work, when deployed to shinyapps.io
parts:
Yes, I guess these multibyte charaters are the cause. Please read this
article: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/unicode.html

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
